validated_results.title: Associations of serum vitamin A and carotenoid levels with markers of prostate cancer detection among US men.
validated_results.reason: The outcomes are PSA-based "markers of prostate cancer detection" cutoffs rather than incident prostate cancer, and zeaxanthin is only measured combined as "lutein + zeaxanthin" with no reported target-specific incidence estimate.

validated_results.title: Association of Pb, Cd, and Se concentrations and oxidative damage-related markers in different grades of prostate carcinoma.
validated_results.reason: Glutathione was measured in blood and prostate tissue of already-diagnosed patients compared across BPH, PIN, and carcinoma grades, providing oxidative-damage biomarker comparisons rather than evidence on prostate cancer incidence.

validated_results.title: Association of Pb, Cd, and Se concentrations and oxidative damage-related markers in different grades of prostate carcinoma.
validated_results.reason: Serum and tissue selenium levels were compared among existing BPH, LGPIN, HGPIN, and carcinoma patients as biomarkers of grade and oxidative damage, with no incident prostate cancer estimate.
